verdict.rationale: Exa is documented only as a hosted, pay-as-you-go API at api.exa.ai, called with an API key. Nothing in the evidence describes self-hosting or on-prem deployment of its search index or engine. The open-source MCP server is a connector to the hosted service, not a self-hostable copy of the core product, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
